install.title: Install the app
install.intro: Installed on your home screen, the app opens like an app and can send you measurement reminders.
install.installed: The app is already installed on this device.

ios.share: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
ios.notifications: On iPhone and iPad, reminders only work once the app is installed (iOS 16.4 or later).

android.menu: In Chrome, open the menu (the three dots at the top right).
android.add: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

desktop.addressBar: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon on the right of the address bar.
desktop.menu: Otherwise, open the browser menu and choose “Install Blood pressure”.

free.hint: Taken outside campaigns: they are not part of the averages or the chart.

protocol.title: Measurement protocol
protocol.intro: For reliable readings, follow the 3-3-3 rule: 3 measurements in the morning and 3 in the evening, 3 days in a row.
protocol.rest: Measure at rest, seated for 5 minutes, back supported and feet flat on the floor.
protocol.noStimulants: No coffee or tobacco in the previous 30 minutes.
protocol.morning: In the morning: before breakfast and before taking any medication.
protocol.evening: In the evening: before going to bed.
protocol.cuff: Cuff on the bare arm, at heart level. Do not talk during the measurement.
protocol.series: Each time, take 3 measurements about 1 minute apart.
